symbols.name: label-space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the ambient label space, $m=h^3=10^6$.
symbols.quote: Nested subspace labels give each vertex of the [exchange network](exchange-network.md) a subspace of an $m$-dimensional space, nested along edges, whose dimension changes count the edge's smaller calls.

symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires of the network under consideration.
symbols.quote: They choose the frames of [Frames on wire arrays](array-frames.md) so that a network of $W$ wires makes $s<Wm$ smaller calls.

symbols.name: number of smaller calls
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls that the network's edges cost.
symbols.quote: They choose the frames of [Frames on wire arrays](array-frames.md) so that a network of $W$ wires makes $s<Wm$ smaller calls.

symbols.name: ground-set size
symbols.meaning: The size of the ground set whose three-element subsets index the network, $h=100$.
symbols.quote: *Triples* (three-element subsets of a ground set of size $h=100$) index the network; bit labels live in $F=\mathbb Q^h$ with the nondegenerate form $\langle x,y\rangle=x^{\mathsf T}y-\frac19(\sum_ix_i)(\sum_iy_i)$, complex ones in $F=\mathbb F_2^h$ with the dot product.

symbols.name: one-factor label space
symbols.meaning: The space $\mathbb Q^h$ (bit network) or $\mathbb F_2^h$ (complex network) with its bilinear form.
symbols.quote: *Triples* (three-element subsets of a ground set of size $h=100$) index the network; bit labels live in $F=\mathbb Q^h$ with the nondegenerate form $\langle x,y\rangle=x^{\mathsf T}y-\frac19(\sum_ix_i)(\sum_iy_i)$, complex ones in $F=\mathbb F_2^h$ with the dot product.

symbols.name: triple indicator
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector in $F$ of a triple $T$.
symbols.quote: Indicator vectors $t_S,t_T$ of triples $S,T$ satisfy $t_S^{\mathsf T}t_T=|S\cap T|$ and sum to $3$, so $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-1$; over $\mathbb F_2$, $t_S\cdot t_T=|S\cap T|\bmod 2$.

symbols.name: ambient label space
symbols.meaning: The space $F^{\otimes3}$ of $h\times h\times h$ arrays, of dimension $m$, in which all labels lie.
symbols.quote: The space $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$ of $h\times h\times h$ arrays has dimension $m=h^3$; $x\otimes y\otimes z$ has entries $x_iy_kz_l$, forms multiply factorwise and $\dim(U\otimes V)=\dim U\dim V$.

symbols.name: bank size
symbols.meaning: The number of index tuples $a$ of triples, so the number of wires in each data bank.
symbols.quote: $N$ counts the tuples $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ of triples indexing the data wires $X_a,Y_a$.

symbols.name: terminal line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}$, the source label of $X_a$.
symbols.quote: With $U_a=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ the terminal labels are

symbols.name: total dimension loss
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges.
symbols.quote: If decreasing edges lose $L$ dimensions in all, absolute changes total $Wm-2N+2L$; saving needs small $L$.

symbols.name: stage number
symbols.meaning: The stage, 1, 2 or 3, whose invocations vary coordinate $a_j$.
symbols.quote: Stage $j$ varies $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: exposed factor space
symbols.meaning: The tensor product $F^{\otimes(j-1)}$ of the factors already exposed before stage $j$.
symbols.quote: Stage $j$ varies $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: earlier tensor line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}$ inside $A$.
symbols.quote: Stage $j$ varies $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: complement of P
symbols.quote: Stage $j$ varies $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: later tensor line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}$, tensored onto every label of stage $j$.
symbols.quote: Stage $j$ varies $a_j$; put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: invocation count
symbols.meaning: The number of invocations over all three stages.
symbols.quote: With $I$ invocations of $\gamma$ central wires each, $L=I\gamma h$.

symbols.name: central wires per invocation
symbols.meaning: The number of central wires in one invocation: 100 in the bit network, 101 in the complex one.
symbols.quote: With $I$ invocations of $\gamma$ central wires each, $L=I\gamma h$.

symbols.name: projection onto a label
symbols.meaning: The rational projection onto the label $U$ along $U^\perp$, the matrix given to a bit-network vertex labelled $U$.
symbols.quote: Bit vertices labelled $U$ get the rational projection $\Pi_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$, except $X_a$'s source ($-\Pi_{U_a}$).

derivations.quote: Indicator vectors $t_S,t_T$ of triples $S,T$ satisfy $t_S^{\mathsf T}t_T=|S\cap T|$ and sum to $3$, so $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-1$; over $\mathbb F_2$, $t_S\cdot t_T=|S\cap T|\bmod 2$. Thus each line $\langle t_T\rangle$ is *nondegenerate* ($\langle t_T,t_T\rangle\neq0$, so $F=\langle t_T\rangle\perp t_T^\perp$), and neighbours (sharing one element, or an even number) are orthogonal.
Source dimensions total $N$ and sink dimensions $Nm+N(m-1)+(W-2N)m=Wm-N$.
Gate wires share the gate's label, so signed changes telescope along wires to $Wm-2N$.

With $A'=A\otimes F,\ B'=(P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle)^\perp_{A'},\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ the outputs $A'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K',\ B'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ are stage $j+1$'s inputs; stage $1$ starts at $U_a,0$ ($B=0$) and stage $3$ ends at $\mathcal F,U_a^\perp$.
Splitting $A=B\perp P$ and $F=\langle t_T\rangle\perp t_T^\perp$ shows every arrow is an inclusion except centre $3\to4$, dropping $P\otimes F$ of dimension $h$; side $2\to5$ needs $t_X\perp t_Y$.

Splitting $A=B\perp P$ and $F=\langle t_T\rangle\perp t_T^\perp$ shows every arrow is an inclusion except centre $3\to4$, dropping $P\otimes F$ of dimension $h$; side $2\to5$ needs $t_X\perp t_Y$. With $I$ invocations of $\gamma$ central wires each, $L=I\gamma h$.
As $I=3\binom h3^2$ and $N=\binom h3^3$, $L/N=3\gamma h/\binom h3$, below $1/2$: $L_{\rm b}/N=100/539$ and $L_{\rm c}/N=101/539$ for $\gamma=100,101$

For $U\subset V$, $\Pi_V-\Pi_U$ (identity on $V\cap U^\perp$, zero on $U\perp V^\perp$) has rank $\dim V-\dim U$, as does its negative. Only $X_a$'s first edge, into a gate labelled $U_a$, differs: $2\Pi_{U_a}$ has rank one, its dimension change zero.
